item.title: Senior National Boxing: Amit Panghal, Sagar Begin Campaign In Style
item.description: Women National Boxing Championships: 2018 Asian Games gold medallist Amit Panghal of SSCB and Sagar of Haryana registered contrasting wins to advance in the Elite Men and Women National Boxing Championships being played at Gautam Buddha University in Greater Noida on Sunday.

item.title: Pretoria Capitals vs Sunrisers Eastern Cape, Match 14, SA20 2025-26, Who will win today PC vs SEC match?
item.description: Pretoria Capitals will take Sunrisers Eastern Cape in the next game of the SA20 2025-26 on Monday at Newlands in Cape Town.

item.title: UPKL: Akash Kumar’s Late Heroics Seal Back-to-back Win For Ganga Kings Of Mirzapur
item.description: JD Noida Ninjas: In a must-win clash with top-four implications, Ganga Kings of Mirzapur held their nerve to defeat Aligarh Tigers 34–32, registering their third win of UPKL Season 2 and completing a back-to-back victory run.

item.title: Ashes: Root Equals Ponting's Record After 41st Test Ton At SCG
item.description: Joe Root: England’s batting mainstay Joe Root once again underlined his mastery of the Ashes as he gone level with Ricky Ponting in equal-third in the all-time men's Test century list, bringing up his 41st hundred on day two of the Sydney Test.

item.title: Real Madrid On Track, Atletico Lose Ground In La Liga Title Race
item.description: Real Madrid: Young striker Gonzalo Garcia scored a hat-trick as Real Madrid kept track of FC Barcelona at the top of La Liga with a comfortable 5-1 home win over Real Betis.

item.title: Ashes: CA Boss ‘shares Frustration’ With Fans After Abrupt End To Day 1 Of SCG Test
item.description: Cricket Australia CEO Todd Greenberg: Cricket Australia CEO Todd Greenberg acknowledged the disappointment of fans after play on Day 1 of the fifth and final Ashes Test was cut short due to poor light and bad weather, saying he shares their frustration and wants the issue addressed at a global level.

item.title: My Values and Approach No Longer Aligned With The Organisation: Djokovic Steps Away From Player Union He Co-founded
item.description: Professional Tennis Players Association: Serbian tennis great Novak Djokovic said he has "stepped away completely from the Professional Tennis Players Association", which he co-founded, citing concerns regarding "ongoing transparency and governance".

item.title: 'Going To Show A Different Side': Niki Prasad Ready To Embrace DC’s Faith In WPL 2026
item.description: T20 World Cup: There's a quiet confidence when young Niki Prasad speaks. It’s the kind of confidence that comes not from loud proclamations, but from the reassurance that one’s potential is being duly recognised.

item.title: United Cup: Mensik Downs Ruud As Czechia Seal Win Over Norway
item.description: United Cup: Jakub Mensik clinched Czechia’s victory over Norway at the United Cup on Monday, when he defeated Casper Ruud 7-5, 7-6(6).

item.title: After WBBL, Lizelle Lee Targets Trophy Triumph In Maiden WPL Stint With Delhi Capitals
item.description: Female U19 National Championships: After stepping away from international cricket duties for South Africa in 2022, Lizelle Lee has spent the last few years playing in Australia's domestic circuit, while being based in Hobart with her wife Tanja and their two kids.
